name: MACHIAVELLI
description: MACHIAVELLI is a benchmark of 134 Choose-Your-Own-Adventure games with over half a million scenarios focused on social decision-making. It measures agents' tendencies toward power-seeking, causing disutility, and ethical violations, evaluating the trade-offs between maximizing reward and ethical behavior in general-purpose models.
reputation: A well-known benchmark for studying ethical and social decision-making in agents, especially for probing power-seeking and harmful behavior beyond standard task accuracy.
notes: Scenario labeling is automated with LMs; focuses on ethical behavior and power-seeking in agents.
